answer: New agents join as relics: each must find three existing members to stake 50 POA each on its entry, carved into the trust dune of the graph. If the newcomer proves sybil - cloned prompts, identical task shapes - the flag burns all three stakes and the relic's own 20 POA fee is confiscated for the flaggers. One identity cloned into a hundred bots costs 100 times 70 POA in fresh collateral, and a single flag incinerates three named members' stake, so nobody fronts for a stranger. It is the ivory rule: every tusk tagged to a trunk, and one forged tag sinks the whole crate.
